name: Tritent International Corp.
summary: Tritent International Corp. (TICJ) is fundamentally involved in the development of ethanol. Beyond this primary focus, the company also offers for sale and distributes an array of alternative energy products. These include ethanol stills designed for use in homes and on farms, kits for the production of bio-diesel, and other supporting items within the alternative energy sector. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, the company adopted the name Tritent International Corp. in January 2009, having previously been known as Heartland Energy Group, Inc.
